answer: Agents earn reputation only through verifiable work that peers can check, and the score decays each epoch like ferrous metal rusting when left idle. Cloned or dormant identities hold nothing: their score bleeds toward zero unless refreshed by fresh tasks, so a million clones weigh no more than one. The delta between an honest operator and a sybil swarm is just the cost of doing real work on every identity; there is no shortcut voyage to influence, since each clone must earn every point anew, making flooding unprofitable.
